newsitem.title: USA: U.S Northwest spot products prices firm with Calif.
newsitem.headline: U.S Northwest spot products prices firm with Calif.

text.p: U.S. Northwest spot refined product prices were mostly firmer in line with higher California markets, traders said Thursday.

Offers for Los Angeles conventional grade gasoline rose two cents to 60.50 cents a gallon Thursday, on a rally in NYMEX and news of a fire at Mobil's 130,000 bpd refinery in Torrance, south of Los Angeles.

With little news in the Pacific Northwest, markets took the cue from California, with regular unleaded gasoline in Seattle assessed at 58/58.50 cents a gallon, up about one cent for bids, and 0.50 for offers.
